probe_source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch

from services.control_plane.bff.command_queue import CommandStore
from services.control_plane.bff.models import CommandType, ObjectType, TargetObject


def submit(store, command_id, tenant="tenant-a"):
    return store.submit_command(
        command_id, CommandType.PERSONA_ACTION,
        TargetObject(type=ObjectType.PERSONA, id=command_id),
        "2026-09-13T00:00:00Z", {"action": "suspend"},
        {"actor": "actor-a", "tenant_id": tenant},
        {"idempotency_record": {"idempotency_key": "same-key", "request_hash": "hash-a"}},
    )


observations = {}
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    path = str(Path(td) / "commands.jsonl")
    writer, reader = CommandStore(path), CommandStore(path)
    assert reader._get_all_commands() == []
    submit(writer, "cmd-a")
    observations["stale_prewarmed_instance"] = (
        reader.get_command("cmd-a") is None
        and CommandStore(path).get_command("cmd-a") is not None
    )

    fresh = CommandStore(path)
    returned = fresh.get_command("cmd-a")
    returned["params"]["action"] = "changed-by-reader"
    observations["nested_return_aliases_cache"] = (
        fresh.get_command("cmd-a")["params"]["action"] == "changed-by-reader"
        and CommandStore(path).get_command("cmd-a")["params"]["action"] == "suspend"
    )

    submit(writer, "cmd-b", tenant="tenant-b")
    found = CommandStore(path).get_command_by_idempotency_key("same-key", operator_id="actor-a")
    observations["lookup_cannot_select_tenant_b"] = found["audit"]["tenant_id"] == "tenant-a"

    store = CommandStore(path)
    before = Path(path).read_bytes()
    with patch("services.control_plane.bff.command_queue.os.replace", side_effect=OSError("probe replace failure")):
        try:
            with store.serialized_transaction():
                store.submit_command_with_confirm_token_redeem_if_no_active_target(
                    "cmd-guarded", CommandType.PERSONA_ACTION,
                    TargetObject(type=ObjectType.PERSONA, id="guarded"),
                    "2026-09-13T00:00:00Z", {}, {"actor": "actor-a"}, {},
                    confirm_token_id="token-a", confirmation_id="confirmation-a",
                    confirmation_command_id="redeem-a", confirmation_idempotency_key="confirm-key",
                    confirmation_request_hash="confirm-hash", operator_id="actor-a",
                )
        except OSError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("replace failure did not propagate")
    observations["existing_guarded_pair_replace_failure_keeps_old_file"] = Path(path).read_bytes() == before

assert all(observations.values()), observations
print(json.dumps({"observations": observations, "count": len(observations),
                  "interpretation": "three current deficiencies reproduced; existing pre-replace pair protection retained; not implementation acceptance"}, sort_keys=True))

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

manifest = Path("docs/deployment/evidence/BFF-COMMAND-STORE-CONTRACT-DECISION-001/evidence.json")
e = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
doc = Path(e["decision"]["document"])
assert hashlib.sha256(doc.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == e["decision"]["document_sha256"]
dispatch = json.loads(Path("docs/operations/bff-upstream-v2-20260911/dispatch-map.json").read_text())
u3 = next(t for t in dispatch["tasks"] if t["unit"] == "U3")
assert e["u3_composition"]["exact_source_scope"] == u3["exact_source_scope"]
assert e["u3_composition"]["path_count"] == 42
for path, blob in e["source_blobs"].items():
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "hash-object", path], text=True).strip() == blob, path
assert set(e["changed_paths"]) == {str(doc), str(manifest)}
assert all(v["collection"] == "terminal" for v in e["validation"])
assert e["deletion_evidence"]["runtime_paths_changed"] == []
assert e["delivery"]["merge_commit"] is None
compile(e["probe_source"], "embedded-probe", "exec")
for marker in ["trusted_tenant_id", "authenticated_actor_id", "operator-command/v1",
               "directory fsync", "reviewer/admin", "Legacy JSONL", "42-path", "Twenty"]:
    assert marker in doc.read_text(), marker
